selected_evidence.summary: /etc/issue contains the exact text, active tty1 getty uses issue display, and the post-reboot tty1 screen buffer directly shows “Authorized access only”.
Live unauthenticated SSH probes to node1’s managed IP displayed the exact banner both before and after reboot; sshd remained active and listening.

Healthy baseline boot ID 5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc was captured; safe reboot scheduling was acknowledged; node1 returned running with changed boot ID 7334aa0e-9a25-477f-994e-37c00cae50e8; sshd, tty1 getty, banner files, local display, and live SSH banner all recovered.
